rubric: All arms receive exactly the same Russian question and isolated snapshot. Six actions, 96 evidence items, 25 seconds. Useful full requires all gold facts and correct status. Useful partial requires all supported facts and an explicit gap at each unsupported demand. Strict partial also requires the correct reason on that clause. Report false completion even when nominal status is correct but evidence is missing, and claims about an unrelated target separately. Account for steps, latency, calls and tokens. No changes to model or policy after first exposure. Corpus is authored, not an external blind test.
